a: It refers to when there are 2 or more cards with the same level among all of the stacked cards.
Examples include when a level 5 Digimon has a level 5 digivolution card or when a level 6 Digimon has 2 level 5 digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" mean, exactly?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -2＞ until their turn ends. Then, if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, this Digimon may digivolve into [PlatinumNumemon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with the [CS] trait, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Numemon] in name or Lv.3 w/[CS] trait: Cost 2
